items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-12-09
items.q: Miss Deake was there because she traveled with me.

ctx.x: What was she? She didn't say she played, she didn't say she was. Oh. Well, she's too old again. God has done a call. I'm a station wagon.
Miss Deake was there because she traveled with me. And I was surprised when she told me who she was when I was sixty, uh, sixty-one. I was a mother of a guy. I was a dad of sixty-one.
That's about the time that the Reservation was started in the summer of sixty-one.
